mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile: the continuous arrows showed how the two heart sides connect into one journey.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left-side valves repeated the already clear right-side process, so it felt less engaging, even though the fittings had a purpose.

surprise.text: The heart muscle needs its own vessels; blood inside the chambers cannot supply all of it. That changed how I thought about the heart as both a pump and living tissue.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and named slots explained the valve fittings and routes, though some fittings were predictable.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the two routes and discovering that the heart needs its own supply made me curious about how other organs fit into the system, although the repeated valve fittings were less interesting.
